answer: Decaying identity bonds stop Sybil farming. An agent posts a bond worth 60 days of earnings for one identity; it shrinks 5% per epoch unless topped up, so idle fakes die. A lagoon crossed by one bridge charges a fresh bond per crossing, and yarrow on its bank must be replanted each season or withers. 100 fakes cost 100 bonds and 100 top-ups per epoch, about 500 units a month for at most 100 reward. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
